knowledge_gaps: The residual is not reproducible yet: k, decay rate, embedding scaling, LayerNorm affine parameters, gate granularity, regularization and search ranges are unspecified. A sigmoid bounds the gate, but does not bound the residual’s magnitude relative to SASRec features, particularly with trainable LayerNorm scale.

The ablation plan is ambiguous: 'gate-only' is undefined. Include last-item-only and uniform-pooling controls to distinguish recency weighting from additional capacity or repeated-item frequency. Position-based decay also differs from timestamp-based recency.

The diagnostic adapter remains underspecified despite being the starting research problem. Define final-position selection, candidate construction, tie handling, sample counts, unavailable-value handling and preservation of model mode and random-number state. Training-loader probes cannot establish validation generalization.

The experiment plan lacks trial counts, checkpoint-selection rules and a compute allocation within 43,200 GPU-seconds. Repeated selection on 800 fixed validation users can overfit validation; paired uncertainty estimates do not eliminate this selection bias.

Originality 4/10 is plausible, but potential 7/10 is speculative and difficulty 3/10 covers mainly the architectural edit. Existing references support diagnostic controls more directly than the proposed residual; direct comparisons with established recency-pooling methods are missing.
